summary: Fleet Telemetry API v2 moves all endpoints from /v1/... to /v2/... and bumps FleetSnapshot.api_version to "v2" (v1 deprecated, shut off 2026-12-01). Orientation changes from Euler degrees (intrinsic Z-Y-X) to unit quaternion (Hamilton, scalar last) and scalar noise (isotropic 1-sigma, metres) is replaced by 6x6 pose covariance. Adds required health (0..1, alert below 0.5).

endpoints_renamed.notes: All endpoints move from /v1/... to /v2/...; v1 endpoints are deprecated and will be shut off on 2026-12-01.

fields_removed.notes: Removed isotropic 1-sigma position uncertainty, metres. Replaced by 6x6 covariance. Scalar equivalent sigma = sqrt(trace(P_pos)/3); anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block.

Removed degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X, part of body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Replaced by unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last; q and -q are same rotation and qw may be negative.

Removed degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X, part of body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Replaced by unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last; q and -q are same rotation and qw may be negative.

Removed degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X, part of body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Replaced by unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last; q and -q are same rotation and qw may be negative. If you still need heading, use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

fields_added.notes: Added 6x6 symmetric pose covariance as nested row-major arrays. Variable order x, y, z (m) then rotation about X, Y, Z (rad). The position block covariance[0:3][0:3] is in m². Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. Scalar equivalent sigma = sqrt(trace(P_pos)/3).

Added required health (0..1): composite localisation/drive health from the on-robot monitor. 1 = nominal; values below 0.5 mean the robot should be serviced. Ops dashboards should raise a health alert below 0.5.

Added unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. If heading needed: yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)).
